architecture: Same joint native-C backbone/planner; external D4/D6 off by default

data.broader_JD_admission: Prepare missing audio, resolve duplicate/cross-corpus group identities, admit independently tracked coaches and valid observed windows; retain masks and native timestamps. Raw video counts are not independent sample counts.

learning.targets: Observed regional continuous speed profiles, lower speed quantiles, slowing/release and duration; whole-body pause separate from foot support
learning.sampling: Prospective TRAIN-only slow/medium/fast stratification after mask/pose review; no arbitrary variance reward
learning.quiet_loss: Stable BCEWithLogits; retain nonzero slowdown gradients from initially fast output
learning.raw_3D_stability_constraints: Retain raw temporal, root/support, floor and bone-geometry checks; physical reference is not fabricated JD3D ground truth
learning.D7_pacing_anchoring: Separate preregistered ablation if required; do not silently remove all safeguards

acceptance: Compare actual unfiltered native output with the frozen reference on BOTH songs and development; raw3D stability, target slow/fast timing, source/shift/donor sensitivity and actual emitted DMX. Improved variation or different hashes alone do not qualify. Artistic review remains separate.
